integrity: Full proof, source comparisons and an optional finite exact checker are supplied. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The sufficient cutoff is not asserted optimal. The proof uses the established Lam–Leung weight theorem, and makes no claim for elements whose order has a p-part or for general composite moduli. Earlier quantitative norm bounds might overlap.
title: An explicit cyclotomic-norm cutoff for minimal vanishing power sums
